Twingate Notifier 
Copyright (C) 2026 Twingate

Usage: twingate-notifier [COMMAND]

Commands:
  console          Run to receive authentication requests from Twingate service in terminal
  check-notify     Check if notifications are available
  status           Twingate status
  resources        Prints resources as json
  auth             Initiate the authentication process for a locked resource
  reload-settings  Notify daemon about settings change
  sdwan-start      Start sdwan loop in daemon
  sdwan-stop       Stop sdwan loop in daemon
  exit-node        Configure exit node routing
  kube             Configure Kubernetes resources
  ssh              Configure SSH resources
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
